Gold, Silver Prices Face Potential Losses Amid US Data and Elections

Gold and silver prices are anticipated to continue their decline as market sentiment is tested by upcoming US midterm elections and key jobs data. The US dollar remained rangebound ahead of the midterm elections, while bitcoin experienced a significant drop following a large cryptocurrency heist. The Bank of England is also expected to raise interest rates.
